statements.status_notes: The DHI libsndfile Debian rebuild backports upstream commit 1ccd2a18826722c3aa9ed54122ebff20e3b92b10, which copies cue labels with a bounded string copy so that no bytes past the label terminator are read from the uninitialized parse buffer. Debian lists the CVE as unfixed in trixie. See https://github.com/libsndfile/libsndfile/commit/1ccd2a18826722c3aa9ed54122ebff20e3b92b10 and https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-109828

The DHI libsndfile Debian rebuild backports upstream commit 1ccd2a18826722c3aa9ed54122ebff20e3b92b10, which copies cue labels with a bounded string copy so that no bytes past the label terminator are read from the uninitialized parse buffer. Debian lists the CVE as unfixed in trixie. See https://github.com/libsndfile/libsndfile/commit/1ccd2a18826722c3aa9ed54122ebff20e3b92b10 and https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-109828

The DHI libsndfile Debian rebuild backports upstream commit c45de8ed8b1d98ca532e94a00dbfb0e49eb9bb8a, rejecting negative MAT4 dimensions and computing the expected payload size in sf_count_t before comparing file length. See https://github.com/libsndfile/libsndfile/commit/c45de8ed8b1d98ca532e94a00dbfb0e49eb9bb8a and https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-88372
